explanation: erdosproblems.com/968: Erdős asked whether u_n < u_{n+1} < u_{n+2} has infinitely many solutions. The Lean statement asserts the set of such n (shifted indexing) is infinite. The docstring's argument is correct: u_n < u_{n+1} ⟺ n(p_{n+1} − p_n) > p_n, i.e. a gap exceeding p_n/n ∼ log n, and Ford–Maynard–Tao give infinitely many runs of k consecutive gaps ≫ log p · log log p · log log log log p / log log log p. Faithful.
